name: com.chinataxcalc/mcp
title: ChinaTaxCalc — China Expat IIT, BIA Allowance, Annual Bonus & GBA 15% Rebate Engine
description: Calculate China expat IIT net salary, BIA tax-free allowances, annual bonus & GBA 15% rebates.

tools.name: calculate_china_expat_iit_and_net_salary
tools.description: Compute annual and monthly net take-home cash, marginal brackets, employer costs, and tax savings from eight Fapiao-backed BIA allowances across six Chinese cities.

grossAmount.description: Base cash remuneration expressed in the chosen currency before payroll deductions or tax.

incomePeriod.description: Specifies whether grossAmount and BIA inputs are monthly or annualized figures.

currency.description: Reporting currency code used for base pay, BIA items, and returned net figures.

cityId.description: Municipality determining local social insurance base caps and employer rate tables.

socialSecurityMode.description: Select exempt for Shanghai opt-out or treaty protection, otherwise standard capped contributions.

annualBonus.description: Separate annual lump-sum bonus taxed under MOF/STA Announcement 2023 No. 30.

housingRental.description: Fapiao-substantiated housing rent allowance matching the chosen incomePeriod and currency.

childrenEducation.description: Accredited international school tuition reimbursed per period with official invoices.

tools.name: simulate_cumulative_monthly_withholding
tools.description: Simulate January-to-December paycheck variance under STA Announcement 2018 No. 56, highlighting bracket jump months and lumpy school tuition spikes.

monthlyGrossRMB.description: Regular monthly gross salary in Chinese Yuan before statutory exemptions or withholdings.

monthlySSRMB.description: Monthly employee social insurance contribution in RMB (pass 0 when exempt in Shanghai).

monthlyBIARMB.description: Average monthly tax-exempt BIA reimbursements in RMB backed by vendor VAT invoices.

lumpyTuitionMode.description: When true, allocates annualTuitionRMB into 50% semiannual offsets during January and August.

annualTuitionRMB.description: Total annual international school tuition in RMB used when lumpyTuitionMode is enabled.

tools.name: compare_annual_bonus_separate_vs_combined_tax
tools.description: Contrast MOF/STA Announcement 30 separate bonus taxation against combined comprehensive filing and warn about statutory bracket cliff traps.

annualTaxableSalaryRMB.description: Regular annual comprehensive taxable income in RMB after standard 60,000 deduction and exemptions.

annualBonusRMB.description: One-off year-end bonus amount in RMB under evaluation for separate versus combined treatment.

tools.name: analyze_landlord_fapiao_surcharge_roi
tools.description: Evaluate whether paying a landlord surcharge to obtain official housing VAT invoices generates positive after-tax savings at your marginal rate.

monthlyRentRMB.description: Contractual monthly apartment rent in RMB before any landlord invoice markup.

surchargeRatePct.description: Percentage fee demanded by the landlord or agent to issue official tax bureau Fapiao (e.g., 5).

marginalRate.description: Employee top applicable IIT decimal rate between 0.03 and 0.45 (e.g., 0.30 for 30%).

tools.name: calculate_gba_15pct_talent_tax_subsidy
tools.description: Quantify municipal fiscal refunds across nine Greater Bay Area hubs like Shenzhen Qianhai and Guangzhou Nansha where effective burden caps at 15 percent.

actualIITPaidRMB.description: Total China Individual Income Tax actually remitted to the tax bureau for the calendar year in RMB.

taxableIncomeRMB.description: Corresponding annual taxable income base in RMB used by Qianhai or Nansha fiscal rebate rules.

gbaCityId.description: Target Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area municipality administering the 15% refund.

tools.name: compare_cross_border_relocation_net_pay
tools.description: Benchmark equivalent USD compensation across seven global financial hubs against Shanghai expat net pay with cost-of-living index comparisons.

grossUSD.description: Comparable annual gross compensation package denominated in US Dollars.

comparisonHubs.description: List of overseas jurisdictions to benchmark alongside Shanghai China (defaults to all seven hubs).

chinaCityId.description: Mainland Chinese comparison city used for the domestic expat benchmark calculation.

chinaHousingAllowanceUSD.description: Annual Fapiao-backed housing allowance in USD included inside the China package (defaults to 24000).

tools.name: diagnose_six_year_worldwide_tax_rule
tools.description: Track consecutive 183-day residency years and verify whether a continuous 30+ day absence resets non-domiciled offshore income protection.

year.description: Four-digit calendar tax year under review.

residedOver183Days.description: True if physical days inside mainland China reached at least 183 days in that year.

singleAbsenceOver30Days.description: True if at least one single departure outside mainland China exceeded 30 consecutive days.

records.description: Chronological calendar-year presence flags ordered oldest to newest (up to 6+ years).

tools.name: generate_safe_salary_repatriation_checklist
tools.description: Assemble the six mandatory counter verification items, Tax App registration tips, and bilingual SAFE quota exemption text for wiring RMB abroad.

remitAmountRMB.description: After-tax RMB balance intended for outward cross-border bank wire (defaults to 100000).

targetCurrency.description: Foreign settlement currency requested at the Chinese commercial bank counter.
